 Follow ‘Chicago P.D.’ Season 14 Cast Shakeup: 1 Major Star Exits, 2 New Actors Join & 6 Stars Return
 Bradley Stern Updated Sun, November 8, 2026 at 9:46 PM UTC 6 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. There have been some big changes to the cast of Chicago P.D. in Season 14!
 The hit NBC drama returned in October, but one of its original stars has already said goodbye after more than a decade on the show.
 LaRoyce Hawkins , who played Kevin Atwater since the series premiered in 2014, officially exited in the second episode of the season.
 And there's already a new face joining the Intelligence Unit!
 Naiqui Macabroad made his debut as Officer Donovan "Penny" Watts in October, stepping into the spot left open by Atwater's departure.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, Jason Beghe , Marina Squerciati , Patrick John Flueger and several other familiar stars are back.
 We've rounded up the latest cast changes, including who's returning, who's leaving and who's joining Season 14.
 Keep reading to see the Chicago P.D. Season 14 cast changes… 
 LaRoyce Hawkins as Kevin Atwater – EXITED
 LaRoyce Hawkins has officially left Chicago P.D. after 14 seasons!
 The 38-year-old actor made his final appearance as Kevin Atwater in the October 14 episode, titled "Don't Blink."
 Atwater's exit came after a bullet struck his protective vest during a dangerous encounter. The experience made him reconsider his future as a police officer, especially after welcoming a baby boy named Malcolm with Tasha Fox, played by Karen Obilom .
 Advertisement Advertisement Rather than continue putting himself in danger, Atwater decided to leave the Intelligence Unit and take a teaching position at a police academy in Atlanta.
 The episode was directed by former cast member Jesse Lee Soffer , who previously played Jay Halstead.
 Following the episode, LaRoyce thanked fans for supporting him throughout his time on the series.
 His character survived, leaving open the possibility of a future appearance, although no return has been confirmed.
 According to NBC Chicago , the actor's departure marked the end of his run as one of the show's original cast members.
 Naiqui Macabroad as Donovan "Penny" Watts – NEW ADDITION
 There's a new officer joining the team following LaRoyce 's departure!
 Advertisement Advertisement Naiqui Macabroad made his Chicago P.D. debut in the October 28 episode, titled "My Eye, My Call."
 He plays Officer Donovan "Penny" Watts, a patrol officer who has spent years working in Chicago's 11th District.
 The character catches the attention of Hank Voight after getting involved in an investigation connected to a murder in his neighborhood.
 Voight is impressed by his determination and knowledge of the community, eventually offering him a position with the Intelligence Unit.
 According to Radio Times , Naiqui 's arrival fills the vacancy left by Kevin Atwater.
 The actor previously appeared in shows including Power , Law & Order , Timeless and StartUp .
 Kyle Selig as Charlie Boyden – NEW ADDITION
 Kyle Selig is one of the new faces on Chicago P.D. in Season 14!
 Advertisement Advertisement The actor made his debut in the October 7 season premiere as FBI Agent Charlie Boyden, who has been assigned to oversee Hank Voight's Intelligence Unit.
 Charlie's job is to determine whether the team is making efficient use of its resources, and his evaluation could potentially lead to the unit being disbanded.
 His arrival has created tension with Voight, who isn't quite sure what to make of the new agent.
 Showrunner Gwen Sigan told NBC Insider that Charlie is an unusual character who Voight has trouble reading, making him a different kind of challenge for the longtime sergeant.
 Kyle is also known for his Broadway work, including Mean Girls , The Book of Mormon and Water for Elephants .
 Jason Beghe as Hank Voight – RETURNING
 Jason Beghe is back as Sergeant Hank Voight!
 Advertisement Advertisement The 66-year-old actor has led the NBC drama since its premiere in 2014.
 In Season 14, Voight is dealing with the departure of longtime Intelligence Unit member Kevin Atwater, along with the arrival of FBI Agent Charlie Boyden.
 Charlie has been assigned to evaluate the unit, and Voight has grown increasingly suspicious of his motives.
 Marina Squerciati as Kim Burgess – RETURNING
 Marina Squerciati is back as Detective Kim Burgess.
 The actress has been part of the show since the beginning, with her character growing from a patrol officer into one of Intelligence's key detectives.
 Season 14 continues exploring Kim's marriage to Adam Ruzek and their family life.
 Advertisement Advertisement In an October interview with TV Insider , Marina revealed that Kim is struggling to feel comfortable in the new house she shares with Adam, even as their marriage remains stable.
 Patrick John Flueger as Adam Ruzek – RETURNING
 Patrick John Flueger is returning as Officer Adam Ruzek.
 The 42-year-old actor has played the character since Season 1.
 Ruzek remains a member of the Intelligence Unit, where he continues working alongside his wife, Kim Burgess.
 Adam and Kim are navigating married life in Season 14, with the couple moving into a new house. Marina Squerciati revealed that their marriage is stable, although Kim has been struggling to adjust to the move.
 Amy Morton as Trudy Platt – RETURNING
 Amy Morton is back as Desk Sergeant Trudy Platt.
 Advertisement Advertisement The actress has been part of the franchise since its early years and continues portraying the longtime Chicago police sergeant.
 Trudy remains part of the district in Season 14, although her character has had limited screen time in the season's opening episodes.
 Benjamin Levy Aguilar as Dante Torres – RETURNING
 Benjamin Levy Aguilar is returning as Officer Dante Torres.
 The actor first joined Chicago P.D. in Season 9 before becoming a series regular in Season 10.
 Season 14 is also exploring Dante's connection with fellow officer Eva Imani. Showrunner Gwen Sigan revealed that the two characters share a close bond that will continue developing as they work together.
 Arienne Mandi as Eva Imani – RETURNING
 Arienne Mandi is back as Officer Eva Imani.
 Advertisement Advertisement The actress joined the show in Season 13 and is continuing as part of the Intelligence Unit in Season 14.
 In Season 14, Eva is dealing with the fallout from her complicated relationship with her long-lost sister, Shari.
 Showrunner Gwen Sigan has also confirmed that the season will continue exploring Eva's connection with Dante Torres.
 Is Anyone Else Leaving Chicago P.D. in Season 14?
 So far, LaRoyce Hawkins is the major confirmed cast departure from Season 14.
 The show's six other established regulars remain part of the lineup, with Naiqui Macabroad introduced as a new member of the Intelligence Unit.
 The series has not announced additional departures from that returning group.
 Advertisement Advertisement Chicago P.D. airs Wednesdays at 10 p.m. ET/PT on NBC, with new episodes streaming the following day on Peacock.
